meaning: The builder-decided values of one ACTUAL Orbio relay release (orbio-list-price-1). It approves these values for a reviewed code registry entry beside hermes-first-call-1, in place of orbio-first-call-1. An operator handoff selects it explicitly; nothing selects it by default. It does not authorize a provider call, a key, a purchase or any spending, and it is not evidence that any provider call ran. See docs/qualification/orbio-release/ORBIO_RELEASE_DRAFT.md.

application_definition_values.images: the same pinned image ids as hermes-first-call-1

price_snapshot.rule: the catalogue list rate USD 2 / 10 per million, which is the rate of the one observed Orbio charge (facts.first_paid_call). No 5% fee is added: that call showed none. A later fee makes the cost check fail, and the hold then stays.

decisions.terms: Step 1: the builder accepted Orbio's terms of service and privacy policy (closes U5).
decisions.routing: Step 3 option (b): a reviewed code change admits a release that names no routing.
decisions.reply_headers: Step 5 option one: the relay records X-Orbio-Ignored-Parameters and X-Orbio-Balance only.
decisions.selection: The operator handoff selects the release. OpenRouter stays a separate approved release.
decisions.price: Builder approval of 2026-11-06: one price, USD 2 / 10 per million tokens, for hold, check and settle.
decisions.cost_mismatch: Builder approval of 2026-11-06: when only the cost check fails, the answer is kept and the whole hold stays.

catalogue.reach: the 65,536-byte request limit cannot reach min_prompt_tokens 272000 (closes U6)

first_paid_call.meaning: The balance drop equals usage.cost exactly, and that cost is the list rate with no fee. One call explains neither why no fee applied nor why X-Orbio-Balance differs (U9).

spending.ledger: one ledger database for every route: OpenRouter and Orbio reservations count against the same caps in the one settings row
spending.maximum_reservation_meaning: The worst-case reservation of one request ((65,536 + 64) prompt tokens x 2 + 4,096 completion tokens x 10, USD per million). An accounting calculation, not an allocation.
spending.credit_purchase: The builder bought USD 5 of balance on 2026-11-06. This release buys nothing.

open.U1: whether usage.cost stays equal to the balance drop beyond the one observed call
open.U2: whether a cost lookup endpoint exists
open.U3: whether a provider object is forwarded, dropped or rejected (this release sends none)
open.U7: whether reasoning, response_format, max_tokens and prompt_cache_options are forwarded or dropped
open.U9: why X-Orbio-Balance read 4.84281 on the first paid call when the balance after it was USD 4.990836, and its timing and precision
open.U10: whether the discount and the 5% fee apply only at purchase or change each request's charge
open.U11: whether the balance is USD cash or inference face value

limits: At most one further model request, after the gate PASS and under the builder approval of 2026-11-06; no fallback and no blind retry.
The model job holds no provider key; the relay alone reads it. No key in logs, model context, source control or application responses.
No funded transaction, policy or wallet change, host deployment or main publication is approved by this release.

replaces.why: The ledger froze orbio-openrouter-managed at USD 2.1 / 10.5 at its first use, and a frozen route price never changes. The old files stay as history, and the old release is no longer approved.
